title: The US DOJ sues Lyft for allegedly discriminating against riders with disabilities, seeking $53M in compensation; Lyft disputes the allegations (Kanishka Singh/Reuters)
summary: Kanishka Singh / Reuters: The US DOJ sues Lyft for allegedly discriminating against riders with disabilities, seeking $53M in compensation; Lyft disputes the allegations — The US Justice Department sued Lyft (LYFT.O) on Monday, alleging the ride-hailing services provider discriminated against passengers with disabilities …
